metadata.comment: The table of changes is small (a few dozen rows at most), so the function reads it whole and finds the row in code. Fetched only after the roles are known, never at graph build.
The same checker as the browser's scripts/settings/check.js (generated from tools/check.src.js by tools/sync-check.mjs): cloud functions cannot use script files yet, so it is pasted here.

nodes.label: A first change to this row
